description: After a heartbreaking loss in Super Bowl LVII to the Chiefs, Jason Kelce reflected on the emotional moments shared with his brother, Travis, who celebrated winning the championship. In a touching moment post-game, Jason embraced Travis, encouraging him to relish the victory, emphasizing that their bond as brothers and family was more important than the game's outcome.

The couple expressed their joy and growth as new parents while navigating this exciting phase together.

A tribunal found that the company had failed to investigate the matter fairly, overlooked findings that cleared him of wrongdoing and wrongly dismissed him. It ordered the company to pay him £34,326.

Military cooperation between North Korea and Russia has significantly increased in recent months.

They defeated second seeds Weronika Falkowska and Alana Smith 6-2, 2-6, 10-8 after a thrilling comeback in the super tie-break. They will face Swiss duo Naima Karamoko and Simona Waltert in the final.

author: TNN
description: Passengers aboard IndiGo flight 6E 451 from Bengaluru to Lucknow experienced panic after a hijack threat note was found. The note was discovered in the aircraft toilet around thirty minutes after take-off, prompting immediate action. Cabin crew alerted the pilot, who decided to return to the Kempegowda International Airport for security checks. Security agencies conducted a thorough search, declaring the threat a hoax after ninety minutes.

Military forces from 11 different nations will engage in combined operations spanning land, air, and maritime areas. The exercise seeks to bolster international cooperation amongst these nations for future engagements.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In 2022, former British Army serviceman Ian Ferguson began stockpiling food after the outbreak of the Ukraine war. Now 71, he has accumulated 600 cans of food in his shed, believing they could help him prepare for a 100-day lockdown or national emergency. He has also gathered camping stoves, radios and other survival equipment.
title: Ex-British soldier, 71, stocks 600 food cans to survive 100-day emergency

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Georgia O’Keeffe’s long-lost artwork, 'Near Abiquiu, New Mexico I', is set to make waves at an upcoming auction. After nearly 40 years hidden in a New York apartment closet, the painting resurfaced thanks to a spontaneous mention by the niece of its original owner. It will be showcased to the public before its auction on November 17, 2026, with proceeds aimed at supporting family projects and educational initiatives.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe painting hidden in closet for 40 years could fetch $3m

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The planning authority has given Wrexham AFC the go-ahead to increase the capacity of the new Kop Stand to 7,750 seats, enhancing the Racecourse Ground's venue status for major global events, such as international football. Work began on the stand in December 2025 and is set for completion by early 2027.

description: Lionel Messi has sparked debate among football fans after being spotted carrying a personalised mate bag featuring the crests of Barcelona, Inter Miami, Newell’s Old Boys and Argentina, but notably excluding Paris Saint-Germain. The omission has fuelled speculation about his relationship with the French club, where he spent two seasons between 2021 and 2023 before joining Inter Miami.

description: KL Rahul proved to be a linchpin for India's ODI squad during the encounter against New Zealand. His unbeaten innings was pivotal amidst the early dismissals of his teammates, securing India’s victory through the DLS method. Meanwhile, New Zealand faltered at the crease, setting a modest target, while India's bowlers delivered with precision and vital wickets. Ultimately, India triumphed by a narrow margin of four runs despite challenging match conditions.

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: India's Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 emphasizes child rehabilitation over punishment. However, the effectiveness of juvenile homes and legal safeguards remains questionable after ten years. Significant issues include staff shortages and delays in processing cases, which hinder timely interventions. Many children are still not receiving adequate education and support in institutional care settings.

The show has been featuring re-aired episodes with celebrity guests amidst the situation. Recently, an episode featuring actors promoting Ramayana was aired for Diwali week. His return to the filming schedule depends on his health improving next week. Amitabh has expressed his gratitude to fans for their support during his health challenges.

He wasn't carried away by the extra bounce, movement in the air or nip off the surface. Instead, he adjusted well to the "trampoline"-like uneven bounce and carry from the playing surface and ran through the opposition with some serious heat.

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: The United States has established Task Force Iron Gate to disrupt Iran's land and Caspian Sea weapons transport. This task force will operate from Tampa, Florida, involving approximately 20 personnel from various US government agencies. The initiative aims to further restrict Iran's capabilities to finance terrorism and rebuild military resources. Washington continues its naval blockade, reportedly preventing over $25 billion in crude oil exports.

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Reigning World Chess Champion D Gukesh visited Tirumala’s Sri Venkateswara Temple to seek blessings ahead of his title defence against Uzbekistan’s Javokhir Sindarov. The 14-game championship will take place in Geneva from November 24 to December 12. Both players will be 20, making it the youngest World Championship clash in chess history. The tournament carries a USD 2.5 million prize fund.

description: Three hunters in Idaho killed 12 wolf pups, receiving up to $2,000 for each animal. The state’s programme reimburses hunters, raising concerns over the use of taxpayer money. Critics have condemned these actions as a form of bounty hunting, especially targeting newborn pups. Wildlife experts have expressed concerns about the method of killings and potential effects on wolf populations.

description: As Diwali 2026 approaches on November 8, the air fills with the spirit of celebration and unity among families and friends. Known for its enlightening traditions, the festival bathes homes in light through diyas and colorful adornments. Emphasizing sustainability this year, communities are reminded to engage in meaningful acts of kindness, celebrating the true essence of joy and gratitude in every small moment.

She downplayed allegations of nepotism while asserting the party's potential to challenge the BJP. Gandhi reflected on her mother-in-law Indira Gandhi's Emergency decision and described it as a mistake. She recounted personal trauma from losing both Indira and her husband Rajiv Gandhi to assassinations.

With a focus on returning astronauts to the Moon, the subsequent establishment of a human presence on Mars signifies America’s commitment to ambitious space ventures, aiming to harness the potential of nuclear propulsion for deep space travel.

description: A recent ruling by the Florida Supreme Court clarified that attorney-fees clauses do not automatically apply to future property owners. The case originated with an easement agreement involving Crown Castle South LLC and RJ's International Trading LLC. Although RJ's secured damages for trespass, it sought attorney fees based on the original agreement. The court determined that the legal-fees clause lacked connection to the use or enjoyment of the land.

Investigators suspect a possible terror angle after a group claimed responsibility for the attack. Forensic teams collected evidence, and CCTV footage is being analyzed to track suspicious activities. A local food delivery executive suffered minor injuries, while no police personnel were harmed in the blast.

The altercation escalated after Dhankar's family previously reported tensions with Sharma's family. Eight days before the incident, repeated arguments occurred between both families regarding parking and a pet dog. Dhankar had just returned from Singapore to attend a family wedding when the shooting took place.

description: Mohammed Shami announced his retirement from Test cricket, concluding a notable 13-year career. Bengal coach Laxmi Ratan Shukla expressed disappointment over Shami's inability to return to the Indian side. Shami last represented India in the 2023 World Test Championship final against Australia. The Cybertruck's sales have disappointed, falling short of Elon Musk's ambitious expectations. Its avant-garde design polarized opinions within the automotive sphere, while Musk's contentious political stances have further tarnished brand loyalty. Nonetheless, some enthusiasts mourn the Cybertruck's rumored end, wishing for its unique presence to continue.

Local officials and cultural activists have since condemned the act, arguing it reflects narrow-mindedness. Police have launched an investigation to identify those responsible for the defacement. description: Kaitlynn Berman, a New York woman, criticized the eight-and-a-half-year sentence given to her attacker. She emphasized that the punishment did not reflect the severity of her injuries. Judge Lewis acknowledged the attack's lasting impact on Berman's life during sentencing. Berman believes the focus should be on the consequences of criminal actions rather than the opportunity for rehabilitation.

description: US midterm elections could shift market dynamics, prompting investors to adopt more defensive positions in their portfolios. Healthcare is anticipated to benefit from advancements in AI as it sees potential growth. Many traditional defensive sectors, however, appear less attractive due to elevated valuations. Goldman Sachs emphasizes the importance of focusing on companies with strong fundamentals for investment.

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: As the midterm elections approach, mounting opposition against data centres is creating a political stir across the United States. Local communities are voicing concerns over soaring electricity costs, excessive water consumption, and environmental repercussions tied to these operations. As tech giants push forward with their agendas, many residents are left questioning whether the expansion truly benefits their neighborhoods.

description: A disturbing incident unfolded in Faridabad as Paramjeet Dhankar lost his life in a violent confrontation over parking with his neighbor Mohan, known as Monu Sharma. Law enforcement is currently investigating and hunting down the fleeing suspect.

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Russia, the US, and India are actively developing long-range strike capabilities for their attack helicopters. The Russian Mi-28NM Havoc has reportedly fired a cruise missile during operations in Ukraine. Concurrently, the US Marine Corps is enhancing the AH-1Z Viper's strike capability with a new modular system. India's Defence Research and Development Organisation has tested a new anti-ship missile from helicopters.

description: European countries are rapidly seeking to replenish their artillery stockpiles, creating significant demand for ammunition and shells. India's defence exports have reached an all-time high, boosted largely by the increasing appetite from Europe. Indian manufacturers now feature prominently in the European arms market, ranking as the third-largest exporter of arms. Notably, the procurement landscape showcases a shift away from earlier reliance on Russian supplies.

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: In a remarkable display of engineering prowess, BYD's Yangwang U9 Xtreme hypercar has achieved a stunning speed of over 500 kmph on a controlled stretch of highway in Abu Dhabi. The feat was executed by celebrated German racing driver Marc Basseng, who benefitted from fine-tuning and optimizations by BYD's engineers prior to this high-stakes test. Limited to just 30 units, the U9 Xtreme sets a new standard for hypercars globally.

description: India secured a narrow victory against New Zealand by four runs in the second ODI match. The Indian pace attack restricted New Zealand to a mere 134 runs in their innings. After a shaky start, Shreyas Iyer and KL Rahul helped stabilize India's chase before the rain interruption. The match concluded early due to rain, but India had managed to stay ahead on the DLS par score.

description: An Indian Air Force IL-76MD has landed at the Mudh-Nyoma airbase, marking a significant achievement. Nyoma is located at 13,700 feet and is one of the highest fighter-capable airbases globally. The new base enhances India's capabilities near the Line of Actual Control in eastern Ladakh. Previous airlift operations showcased the importance of rapid troop and equipment movement in critical situations.

US President Donald Trump downplayed the situation, emphasizing no casualties occurred during the conflict.

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: In 1960, Israel initiated its nuclear program in the Negev desert, disguising it as a textile production facility. Over the years, the United States has upheld a stance of nuclear ambiguity towards Israel's arsenal. Recently, US legislators have expressed a need for greater transparency about this nuclear matter, coupled with military alliance discussions regarding Iran.

He highlighted the importance of backing, discipline and learning from setbacks. Brar's impressive spell helped India bowl New Zealand out for 134, securing a rain-affected four-wicket victory and a 2-0 series lead.

He praised their musical talent, stating it reflects their dedication to serving the country. Meanwhile, the Chiefs are expected to rely on existing receivers Rashee Rice and Xavier Worthy rather than pursue a reunion.

description: The British Royal Family receives £137.9 million through the Sovereign Grant in 2026/27, but a new bill proposes reducing the funding to £99.9 million the following year. His views could lead to heightened scrutiny for skilled workers, especially Indian professionals seeking H-1B visas.

The decision to promote Axar Patel ahead of KL Rahul also raised questions, while Rahul's composure stood out amid a collapse. The contrasting performances exposed India's batting vulnerabilities.

description: In a devastating escalation of conflict near Sanaa, Yemen, airstrikes have left 22 people dead and more than 30 wounded. This latest violence adds to the chaos following a previous assault at the al-Hadara market, where about 30 fatalities were reported. Houthi officials blame Saudi Arabia for the strikes, though Riyadh remains silent.
title: Saudi strike kills 22 people, mostly women & kids, near Yemen's capital

author: AASTHA JHA
title: 'E20 petrol by PSUs meets prescribed quality standards': Oil min rejects K'taka charge

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Michael Dell is investing $406 million in SK Group by purchasing shares from chairman Chey Tae-won. This transaction involves a 1.34% stake in SK Inc, aimed to fund a divorce settlement. Chey Tae-won is selling shares totaling 944 billion won to pay his ex-wife. The investment showcases Dell's connection to SK Group through their partnership in technology infrastructure.
title: Michael Dell is funding South Korea's most-expensive divorce ever

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: Amid rising tensions and fears of US military action, Iran has reportedly begun issuing iodine tablets to individuals in proximity to its nuclear facilities. This proactive step is linked to discussions within the Trump administration regarding renewed military efforts to disrupt Iran's nuclear arsenal. Irag's leadership has expressed concerns about any strikes originating from their territory, signifying the complex geopolitical dynamics at play in the region.
title: Iran distributes iodine pills near nuclear sites as Trump weighs fresh strikes

title: 'Poor Biharis don't know anything': Cong UP in-charge targets BJP chief Nabin

author: AASTHA JHA
description: Sonia Gandhi voiced her dismay over Penguin Random House India's decision to withdraw her memoir, 'Belonging: A Journey of Love', due to disagreements about sensitive subjects involving Prime Minister Narendra Modi. She interpreted this as an effort to inhibit her narrative and suggested possible government influence.
title: Penguin was 'uneasy' with criticism of govt: Sonia Gandhi's 1st reaction to memoir row

author: KANCHAN YADAV
title: Watch: PM Modi extends Diwali wishes, will celebrate festival with soldiers

author: NIKHIL SHARMA
description: A dispute over parking and a pet dog led to a deadly shooting in Faridabad. Paramjeet Dhankar was shot multiple times by his neighbor Mohan Sharma during an argument. The two families had ongoing tensions for several days prior to the incident. Paramjeet, who had recently returned from Singapore, was attending a family wedding. After the shooting, the accused fled from the scene, and police are currently searching for him.
title: Accused arrested for shooting tech excecutive over parking dispute in Haryana

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Texas's Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa is opposing SpaceX's potential acquisition of about 1,300 acres of public land. She requested the Texas Parks and Wildlife Department to pause any action on this matter until her official term begins. Hinojosa emphasized the area's importance and discussed her intentions during conversations with officials. Additionally, she expressed a desire for a constructive relationship with Elon Musk's businesses on public terms.
title: SpaceX eyed 1,300 acres of public land; Texas governor-elect asks to hold off

author: RAJ SHEKHAR JHA
description: Intelligence agencies are currently investigating a social media post linked to a Ghaziabad explosion. The post was released by an obscure group claiming responsibility for the attack. Security measures around vital installations in the National Capital Region have been heightened following this incident. Preliminary evaluations suggest the responsible group may not exist in official terror databases. Investigators believe this incident may be orchestrated to incite panic and communal tension.
title: Police outpost blast: 'Tehreek-ul-Mujahideen Hindustan' post puts agencies on alert

author: RAJIV KALKOD
description: S Indushekhar, a 52-year-old cab driver, is suspected of murdering his wife and six relatives. The victims were reportedly invited to his home for meals before their deaths occurred. Indushekhar was arrested while a minor boy, his eighth target, was found in his vehicle. The accused allegedly used a grindstone to commit these murders during late October.
title: 'TV at full blast, property spat, 20-year feud': New details in B'luru family massacre

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: China and the US are engaged in ongoing dialogues to foster stable trade relations, with emphasis on prior commitments. US officials expressed concern regarding China's adherence to agreements related to rare earth materials and agricultural products. The latest discussions revealed the US's stance that China falls short in fulfilling its responsibilities under the Busan agreement. Moreover, China dismissed accusations of inadequate rare earth supplies and agricultural purchasing.
title: US-China trade talks to continue as Washington presses Beijing to honour Busan deal

author: PRIYANKA JAISWAL
title: ‘Elections matter’: Houston mayor moves to limit ICE cooperation after Democrats’ victory

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Usman Khawaja has shed light on the extent of discussions regarding ball tampering among Australian cricketers. He revealed that these conversations were not only prevalent but also conducted openly during their contentious 2018 tour in South Africa. This revelation casts doubt on the integrity of Cricket Australia's previous investigation, which insists it considered all pertinent information before drawing its conclusions.
title: ‘It was all of us’: Khawaja drops bombshell on Australia's ball-tampering scandal

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: The United States has announced a reward of up to $20 million for information regarding Iran's nuclear program. This reward aims to gather details about facilities, equipment, and personnel involved with the program. Diplomatic efforts are ongoing to resolve tensions and prevent further conflict. Iran has expressed the desire for negotiations but requires certain conditions to be met.
title: US offers $20 million reward for information on Iran's nuclear programme

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Choti Diwali 2026 is set to illuminate the night on November 8, according to the lunar calendar. The festivities revolve around age-old traditions, like lighting diyas and savoring delectable sweets, while family bonds are strengthened. An essential ritual is the Abhyanga Snan, a sacred oil bath meant to cleanse both body and mind. This joyous occasion fosters community spirit, spreading messages of goodwill and celebrating renewal and hope.
title: Happy Choti Diwali 2026: Wishes, images and greetings to share

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: The Bibi Fatima Women's Self-Help Group, spearheaded by Bibijaan Maulasaab Halemani, has successfully revitalized millet agriculture in Karnataka. Spanning 30 villages, this collective empowers local farmers to preserve indigenous seeds through their community seed bank, which boasts over 250 varieties. Their significant contributions to sustainable farming earned them the Plant Genome Saviour Community Award, a testament to their dedication to preserving traditional agricultural practices.
title: Karnataka woman's seed-saving spans 30 villages, wins Rs 10 lakh award

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Aaryan Ghorpade, a North Carolina student, has triumphed in a national competition with EcoRoute, a project that tracks wildlife-vehicle collision hotspots across the U.S. This innovative online tool gathers collision data and produces heat maps to assist transportation agencies in improving road safety. EcoRoute also encourages community involvement, allowing users to report wildlife sightings. Ghorpade envisions further enhancements and plans to partner with wildlife conservation organizations in his state.
title: NC student wins top award for free roadkill-mapping platform to save wildlife

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Stephen King and Tabitha have innovatively turned their Bangor residence into a unique archive and retreat for writers. This initiative offers aid and an inspiring atmosphere, allowing selected authors to immerse themselves in their work. The nearby Brown Mansion will serve as an additional haven, benefitting a variety of literary talents, including educators and Maine local writers.
title: Stephen King's $135,000 Maine home holds archives, funds writer residencies

author: POULOMI GHOSH
title: Kimberly Guilfoyle reportedly moves in with ex-husband after Greece exit

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend'  has successfully crossed the Rs 200 cr mark worldwide within two days of its release and achieved significant earnings. The film, directed by Nitesh Tiwari and featuring Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi, garnered Rs 112.90 cr in India net collections. The film's performance was mostly supported by the Hindi version, contributing to most of the earnings.
title: 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' day 2: Ranbir, Sai starrer crosses Rs 100 cr India net

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: 'Scene', the much-anticipated film from Suriya and Jithu Madhavan, has kicked off with a spectacular box office performance, amassing Rs 34.25 crore in total sales on its opening day, which includes Rs 19.15 crore net from Indian markets. The Tamil rendition has significantly boosted the film's local earnings, highlighting a keen viewer interest.
title: 'Scene' BO day 1: Suriya, Naslen film opens with Rs 34.25 cr worldwide

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Steve-O, the famous Jackass star, has dedicated himself to animal welfare by establishing The Radical Ranch, a sanctuary for rescued animals situated near Nashville. Since its inception as a nonprofit in 2024, the ranch has provided a home for nine animals, including goats and pigs. Steve-O envisions expanding the sanctuary to include cows and chickens while fostering empathy towards all creatures.
title: Steve-O turns 44-acre Nashville ranch into home for rescued animals

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Former actress Victoria Principal has found her true calling in animal rehabilitation, dedicating her life to caring for rescued creatures at her ranch. One notable resident is Halo, a miniature horse currently healing with her support. Principal passionately advocates for the role of love and patience in nurturing these animals back to health, marking a significant departure from her Hollywood days as she embraces her new purpose.
title: Dallas star Victoria Principal, 76, cares for rescued animals on ranch

author: SAHIL MALHOTRA
description: India's cricket team is experiencing a transition under coach Gautam Gambhir while maintaining stability in the ODI format. Senior players like Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma play crucial roles in this transition. Former New Zealand bowler Kyle Mills commends Gambhir's tactical approach and acknowledges the scrutiny faced by the Indian team. New Zealand's cricket has improved significantly with upgraded infrastructure and a rich talent pool.
title: Not an easy task to be coach of the Indian cricket team: Kyle Mills

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: In a significant shift, Donald Trump named Stephen Miller as the new White House chief of staff, a decision that has generated alarm among Democratic lawmakers. Known for his contentious stance on immigration, Miller's rise could escalate tensions on Capitol Hill. Since the 2016 election, he has been instrumental in crafting Trump's domestic policies, which have attracted public criticism and may lead to enhanced Congressional investigations into the current administration.
title: Who is Stephen Miller? Trump's longtime aide gets top White House job

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: The Secret Service took Ronny Yordrix Guanipa Chrinos into custody after he exhibited alarming conduct in his vehicle. When confronted by officers, he insisted that he heard voices commanding him to execute President Trump. A subsequent search of his stolen car revealed three guns and additional ammunition. A Venezuelan national without legal status since March 2024, Chrinos now underscores the persistent dangers faced by the president.
title: 'Voices in head said to kill Trump': Man with firearms arrested near White House

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Kristen Kelly and Serene Williams from Sacred Heart Preparatory have pioneered an Advanced Placement course focused on women's history, garnering endorsement from 100 esteemed universities and colleges. This initiative underscores the vital role women have played throughout history. An eminent gala in Chicago on November 6, 2026, will unveil the inaugural Meryl Streep Educator Award, with proceeds dedicated to bolstering educational resources for women's history.
title: Meryl Streep-backed museum to honour teachers behind AP history push

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Aagam Jain, a passionate student from Hyderabad, has engineered an innovative device named SummitSathi. This unique satellite receiver delivers essential weather updates without needing an internet connection, making it perfect for remote Himalayan villages. Plans are underway to introduce three units across ten villages in the Seraj Valley, significantly enhancing access to crucial weather data.
title: Hyderabad student builds Rs 68,000 satellite receiver for remote villages

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Cleidocranial dysplasia (CCD) affects bone and dental development in patients and requires specialized care. A recent study established 37 expert recommendations for diagnosing and managing this rare condition effectively. These guidelines emphasize the importance of coordinated care among various specialists and regular monitoring. Gaten Matarazzo, who has CCD, advocates for better recognition and treatment of the disorder. CCD Smiles organization aims to support patients through awareness and research initiatives.
title: Stranger Things star's rare disorder charity helps create 37 care guidelines
